about_the_game:
Cubactory: Build, Automate, Discover

Embark on the only factory game where you have the freedom to truly build objects with Cubactory, putting your ingenuity and creativity to the test as you design and optimize a cutting-edge, modular factory. Your mission is to transform cubes of various materials into stunning voxel figures, fulfilling ever more challenging orders that will push your engineering and optimization skills to their limits.

A Riddle in the Sky

High above, an enigmatic Cube floats, expanding with each satisfied order. Your factory houses advanced tools that let you manipulate colored cubes: fuse them to create new materials, blend them for precise hues, carve them into shape, or compact them to assemble complex structures. Every completed order activates one of the 1,000 cubes that make up this mysterious sculpture, bringing you closer to the moment when its true purpose is revealed.

Strategic and Creative Gameplay

You start with basic tools and a handful of cubes, but soon you’ll unlock advanced technologies that turn your factory into a precision-automated system. Use conveyor belts to move cubes between workstations, where specialized machines process them according to each order’s specifications. As orders grow more complex, you’ll need to optimize your production flow—balancing efficiency and creativity to meet exacting requirements of color, shape, and composition.

Factory Management

The key to success is automation. Design networks of conveyor belts that snake through your factory, linking machines that perform specific tasks:

Creative Freedom

Cubactory doesn’t just challenge you to fulfill orders—it grants you total freedom to experiment. Design unique voxel figures, explore innovative combinations, and create objects that reflect your vision. Whether you follow the blueprints or invent your own masterpieces, the possibilities are virtually endless.

The Cube’s Mystery

At the heart of Cubactory lies the floating Cube enigma. Each of its 1,000 pieces is activated upon completing an order, and only when the full sculpture is assembled will you uncover its true purpose. What secrets does this artifact hold?
